draft.title: Strengths and limits of monetary policy
card: Monetary policy can be changed quickly. The RBA Board meets eight times a year and can alter the cash rate target at any of those meetings.
It is run by the RBA, which is independent of the government. This means decisions can be made on economic grounds, without pressure from election timing.
It takes time to work fully. Changes in the cash rate pass through to spending and prices slowly, so the full effect can take a year or more.
It acts on the whole country at once. The RBA cannot aim it at one region or industry, so it may suit some areas and strain others.
draft.remember: Monetary policy is quick to change and independent, but slow to take full effect and not targeted.

a.q: Which is a limit of monetary policy rather than a strength?
opts: Its full effect on spending can take a year or more
The RBA can change the cash rate target at a meeting
The RBA makes decisions independently of the government
Decisions can be made without pressure from election timing
a.why: Changes in the cash rate pass through to spending and prices slowly, so the full effect arrives late. The other three are strengths: speed of change and independence from government.
a.clue: Which one is about how long it takes to work?

b.q: Mining in Western Australia is booming and prices there are rising fast, while Tasmania's economy is weak. The RBA raises the cash rate to slow inflation. Which limit of monetary policy does this show?
opts: It acts on the whole country, so it hits weak regions too
It takes time to work, so the rise will arrive late
It is not independent, so the rise reflects government aims
It cannot be changed quickly, so the RBA must wait months
b.why: A single cash rate applies across Australia, so a rise aimed at a booming region also affects Tasmania, where the economy is weak. The delay is a real limit, but this case is about different regions, not timing.
b.clue: Think about the two regions being treated the same way.

a.best: Its full effect on spending can take a year or more

b.best: It acts on the whole country, so it hits weak regions too
